ASAM UI PRO

增删改查页面

AsamCrudPage

组合查询、列表、编辑和详情视图。

打开独立 CRUD 演示 →

  • 查询表单 AsamSearchForm
  • 表格与分页 AsamOperationsTable
  • 编辑表单 AsamEditorForm
  • 编辑弹窗 AsamFormDialog
  • 资料详情 AsamDetailPanel
  • 详情弹窗 AsamDetailDialog
  • 详情抽屉 AsamDetailDrawer

使用场景

由应用提供数据接口和权限，复用查询表单、表格、编辑弹窗和详情组件。有效查询或重置回到第一页；刷新及编辑保存保留当前页。

完整数据操作

查询、新增和保存用 primary；取消和行内查看编号用 secondary，删除用 danger。状态使用 AsamTag。操作只修改本地示例数据。

vue
<template>
	<AsamCrudPage
		v-model:border="showBorder"
		:controller="controller"
		:table-size="tableSize"
		:size="size"
		title="项目管理"
		description=""
		create-label="新建项目"
		edit-label="编辑项目"
		detail-label="项目详情"
		:action-column-width="homePreview ? 156 : 228"
		:action-button-type="showActionColors ? 'primary' : undefined"
		:save-button-type="showActionColors ? 'primary' : undefined"
		:cancel-button-type="showActionColors ? 'secondary' : undefined"
		:row-actions="showActionColors ? rowActions : undefined"
		:show-heading="tableOnly ? false : undefined"
		:page-padding="tableOnly ? 0 : undefined"
	>
		<template v-if="tableOnly" #query></template>
	</AsamCrudPage>
	<p v-if="showActionColors" role="status">{{ rowActionMessage }}</p>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { h, onBeforeUnmount, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamMessageBox, AsamTag, createAsamDataRuntime } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamControlSize, AsamTableSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamCrudPage, useAsamCrudController } from '@asam-ui/pro/templates/crud';
import {
	createAsamWriteCoordinator,
	createAsamTableOperationCoordinator
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamListAction } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import {
	createProjectMock,
	initialProjectQuery,
	projectEditorConfig,
	projectQueryCodec,
	projectQueryFields
} from './project/ProjectMock.js';
import type { ProjectQuery } from './project/ProjectMock.js';
import type { RichEdit, RichRow } from './project/RichFields.js';

defineOptions({ name: 'SharedCrudExample' });
const props = defineProps<{
	tableSize?: AsamTableSize;
	size?: AsamControlSize;
	homePreview?: boolean;
	tableOnly?: boolean;
	showActionColors?: boolean;
}>();
const showBorder = shallowRef(false);
const rowActionMessage = shallowRef('可用行内的「查看编号」核对项目。');
const rowActions: readonly AsamListAction<RichRow>[] = [
	{
		id: 'show-reference',
		label: '查看编号',
		button: { type: 'secondary', plain: true },
		scope: 'independent',
		run: async ({ row }) => {
			if (row) rowActionMessage.value = `${row.name}：${row.reference}`;
		}
	}
];
const mock = createProjectMock();
const runtime = createAsamDataRuntime();
let sequence = 0;
const confirm = (message: string) =>
	AsamMessageBox.confirm(message, '请确认').then(
		() => true,
		() => false
	);
const tone = (status: string) =>
	status === '进行中'
		? 'primary'
		: status === '已完成'
			? 'success'
			: status === '待启动'
				? 'warning'
				: 'info';
const controller = useAsamCrudController<RichRow, ProjectQuery, RichEdit, string | number>({
	runtime,
	writes: createAsamWriteCoordinator(),
	operations: createAsamTableOperationCoordinator(),
	rowKey: (row: RichRow) => row.id,
	isKey: (key: unknown): key is string | number =>
		typeof key === 'string' || (typeof key === 'number' && Number.isFinite(key)),
	dataset: 'website-projects',
	initial: { ...initialProjectQuery },
	queryFields: projectQueryFields,
	queryCodec: projectQueryCodec,
	...projectEditorConfig,
	services: mock.services,
	detail: { mode: 'load', load: mock.detail },
	columns: [
		{ key: 'name', label: '项目名称', width: props.homePreview ? 180 : 240, required: true },
		...(!props.tableOnly
			? [
					{
						key: 'reference' as const,
						label: '项目编号',
						width: props.homePreview ? 140 : 150,
						flex: false
					}
				]
			: []),
		{ key: 'owner', label: '负责人', width: props.homePreview ? 84 : 96, flex: false },
		{
			key: 'status',
			label: '状态',
			width: props.homePreview ? 96 : 110,
			flex: false,
			render: (row: RichRow) =>
				h(AsamTag, { type: tone(row.status), effect: 'light' }, () => row.status)
		},
		{ key: 'dueDate', label: '截止日期', width: props.homePreview ? 96 : 126, flex: false }
	],
	preferences: {
		scope: {
			application: 'docs',
			principal: 'visitor',
			table: 'website-projects',
			version: '2'
		},
		adapter: { load: async () => null, save: async () => {}, reset: async () => {} }
	},
	allowed: () => true,
	allowedRemove: () => true,
	confirmDiscard: () => confirm('放弃未保存内容？'),
	confirmRemove: () => confirm('删除所选项目？'),
	operationId: (action) => `website-${action}-${++sequence}`
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	controller.dispose();
	runtime.invalidate();
});
</script>
ts
import type { AsamCrudCodec, AsamCrudServices } from '@asam-ui/pro/templates/crud';
import type { AsamFieldDefinition } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { defineAsamOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamOption } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { richCodec, richEquals, richFields } from './RichFields.js';
import type { RichEdit, RichRow } from './RichFields.js';

export interface ProjectQuery {
	name: string;
	owner: string | null;
	status: string | null;
	reference: string;
	dueDate: string | null;
	priority: string | null;
}
export const initialProjectQuery: ProjectQuery = {
	name: '',
	owner: null,
	status: null,
	reference: '',
	dueDate: null,
	priority: null
};
export const owners = ['陈晨', '林悦', '张远', '许宁', '周可', '沈知'];
export const statuses = ['进行中', '待启动', '已完成', '已暂停'];
const names = [
	'华东供应链协同平台',
	'园区设备巡检',
	'研发知识库升级',
	'客户服务工作台',
	'渠道结算自动化',
	'华南仓储可视化',
	'数据治理与指标口径统一',
	'生产计划排程',
	'质量追溯系统',
	'移动审批助手',
	'合同归档与检索',
	'团队协作空间'
];
const source = (values: readonly string[]) =>
	defineAsamOptions().static({ options: values.map((value) => ({ value, label: value })) });
const choice = (key: string, label: string, values: readonly string[]): AsamFieldDefinition => ({
	key,
	label,
	kind: 'single',
	source: source(values),
	adaptInput: (value) => {
		if (value === '' || value === null || value === undefined) return null;
		if (
			typeof value === 'string' ||
			typeof value === 'boolean' ||
			(typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value))
		)
			return value;
		throw new TypeError('选择值必须是合法标量或空值');
	},
	query: (value) => value ?? '',
	modes: { query: { componentProps: { placeholder: '全部', clearable: true } } }
});
export const projectQueryFields: readonly AsamFieldDefinition[] = [
	{
		key: 'name',
		label: '项目名称',
		kind: 'text',
		modes: { query: { componentProps: { placeholder: '输入项目名称', clearable: true } } }
	},
	choice('owner', '负责人', owners),
	choice('status', '项目状态', statuses),
	{
		key: 'reference',
		label: '项目编号',
		kind: 'text',
		modes: { query: { componentProps: { placeholder: '如 PRJ-2026-001', clearable: true } } }
	},
	{
		...richFields.find((field) => field.key === 'dueDate')!,
		modes: {
			query: {
				componentProps: {
					valueFormat: 'YYYY-MM-DD',
					placeholder: '选择日期',
					clearable: true
				}
			}
		}
	},
	choice('priority', '优先级', ['高', '中', '低'])
];
export const projectQueryCodec: AsamCrudCodec<ProjectQuery> = {
	encode: (model) => ({
		...model,
		owner: model.owner || null,
		status: model.status || null,
		priority: model.priority || null
	}),
	decode: (model) => {
		const text = (key: string) => {
			const value = model[key];
			if (value === null || value === undefined) return '';
			if (typeof value !== 'string') throw new TypeError(key);
			return value;
		};
		return {
			name: text('name'),
			owner: text('owner') || null,
			status: text('status') || null,
			reference: text('reference'),
			dueDate: model.dueDate === null ? null : text('dueDate'),
			priority: text('priority') || null
		};
	}
};
const labels: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = {
	name: '项目名称',
	reference: '项目编号',
	category: '项目类型',
	team: '所属团队',
	region: '所属区域',
	status: '项目状态',
	budget: '预算（元）',
	progress: '完成进度',
	channels: '通知渠道',
	enabled: '截止提醒',
	tags: '项目标签',
	time: '提醒时间',
	attachments: '交付附件',
	note: '项目说明'
};
const fieldOrder = [
	'name',
	'reference',
	'category',
	'owner',
	'team',
	'region',
	'status',
	'priority',
	'startDate',
	'dueDate',
	'budget',
	'progress',
	'channels',
	'enabled',
	'tags',
	'time',
	'email',
	'attachments',
	'note'
];
// JS 投影也保留返回类型，避免嵌套字段模式推导成庞大联合。
const definitions = fieldOrder.map(
	/** @returns {import('@asam-ui/pro').AsamFieldDefinition} */ (key): AsamFieldDefinition => {
		const field = richFields.find((item) => item.key === key)!;
		const label = labels[field.key] ?? field.label;
		const group = ['name', 'reference', 'category', 'owner', 'team', 'region'].includes(
			field.key
		)
			? '基本信息'
			: ['status', 'priority', 'startDate', 'dueDate', 'budget', 'progress'].includes(
						field.key
				  )
				? '计划安排'
				: ['attachments', 'note'].includes(field.key)
					? '附件与说明'
					: '协作设置';
		const layout = { ...field.modes?.edit?.layout, group };
		const modes = {
			...field.modes,
			edit: { ...field.modes?.edit, layout },
			detail: { ...field.modes?.detail, layout }
		};
		if (field.key === 'email')
			return {
				...field,
				label,
				submitHidden: true,
				submit: (value: unknown) => value,
				modes: {
					...modes,
					edit: { ...modes.edit, hidden: true },
					detail: { ...modes.detail, hidden: true }
				}
			};
		if (field.key === 'region')
			return {
				...field,
				label,
				format: (value: unknown) =>
					value === 'hz' ? '中国 / 浙江 / 杭州' : String(value ?? '—'),
				modes: {
					...modes,
					edit: {
						...modes.edit,
						componentProps: {
							props: { emitPath: false },
							placeholder: '请选择区域',
							options: [
								{
									value: 'cn',
									label: '中国',
									raw: { code: 'cn' },
									children: [
										{
											value: 'zj',
											label: '浙江',
											raw: { code: 'zj' },
											children: [
												{ value: 'hz', label: '杭州', raw: { code: 'hz' } }
											]
										}
									]
								}
							] satisfies readonly AsamOption<string, { code: string }>[]
						}
					}
				}
			};
		if (field.key === 'reference')
			return {
				...field,
				label,
				modes: {
					...modes,
					edit: { ...modes.edit, readonly: false, componentProps: { readonly: true } }
				}
			};
		if (field.key === 'name' || field.key === 'owner')
			return {
				...field,
				label,
				modes: {
					...modes,
					edit: {
						...modes.edit,
						componentProps: {
							placeholder:
								field.key === 'name' ? '请输入项目名称' : '输入或选择负责人'
						}
					}
				}
			};
		if (field.key === 'progress')
			return {
				...field,
				label,
				format: (value: unknown) => `${String(value)}%`,
				modes: {
					...modes,
					edit: {
						...modes.edit,
						componentProps: { ...modes.edit.componentProps, showInput: true }
					}
				}
			};
		if (field.key === 'enabled')
			return {
				...field,
				label: '截止提醒',
				format: (value: unknown) => (value ? '开启' : '关闭'),
				modes: {
					...modes,
					edit: {
						...modes.edit,
						componentProps: { activeText: '已开启', inactiveText: '已关闭' }
					}
				}
			};
		if (field.key === 'tags' || field.key === 'note')
			return {
				...field,
				label,
				modes: {
					...modes,
					edit: {
						...modes.edit,
						componentProps: {
							...modes.edit.componentProps,
							placeholder:
								field.key === 'tags'
									? '输入后按 Enter 添加'
									: '填写目标、交付范围或协作事项',
							...(field.key === 'note' ? { rows: 3 } : {})
						}
					}
				}
			};
		if (field.kind === 'single') {
			const values =
				field.key === 'status'
					? statuses
					: field.key === 'category'
						? ['平台建设', '流程优化', '数据分析']
						: field.key === 'team'
							? ['平台研发组', '客户体验组', '运营协作组']
							: undefined;
			if (values)
				return { ...field, label, source: source(values), control: 'select', modes };
		}
		return { ...field, label, modes };
	}
);
export const projectFields = definitions;
export const projectEditorConfig = {
	editFields: projectFields,
	detailFields: projectFields,
	editCodec: richCodec,
	equals: richEquals
};
function copy(model: RichEdit): RichEdit {
	return richCodec.decode(richCodec.encode(model));
}
function defaults(): RichEdit {
	return richCodec.decode({
		name: '',
		reference: '保存后自动生成',
		owner: '',
		team: '平台研发组',
		category: '平台建设',
		region: 'hz',
		status: '待启动',
		email: '',
		note: '',
		startDate: '2026-10-30',
		dueDate: '2026-11-30',
		priority: '中',
		budget: 0,
		progress: 0
	});
}
/** 仅视觉演示内存服务；控制器、校验和写入入口仍消费正常公共包。 */
export function createProjectMock(empty = false) {
	const rows = new Map<string | number, RichRow>();
	if (!empty)
		for (let index = 0; index < 24; index++) {
			const id = index + 1;
			rows.set(id, {
				...defaults(),
				id,
				version: 1,
				name: names[index % names.length]! + (index >= names.length ? ' · 二期' : ''),
				reference: `PRJ-2026-${String(id).padStart(3, '0')}`,
				owner: owners[index % owners.length]!,
				status: statuses[[0, 1, 0, 2, 3, 0][index % 6]!]!,
				startDate: '2026-10-01',
				dueDate: `2026-11-${String(5 + index).padStart(2, '0')}`,
				priority: index % 3 ? '中' : '高',
				budget: 48000 + index * 3200,
				progress: [68, 0, 42, 100, 35, 76][index % 6]!,
				tags: ['重点项目', '跨团队'],
				attachments: [
					{
						id: `project-spec-${id}`,
						name: '项目交付清单与里程碑计划.pdf',
						url: `/__mock-project-documents__/${id}`,
						mimeType: 'application/pdf',
						size: 1887437
					}
				],
				note: '统一项目计划、交付资料与跨团队协作。当前里程碑为完成核心流程联调，下一阶段进入使用反馈与体验优化。'
			});
		}
	let sequence = 100;
	const applied = new Set<string>();
	const services: AsamCrudServices<RichRow, ProjectQuery, RichEdit, string | number> = {
		async list(request) {
			const filtered = [...rows.values()].filter((row) =>
				Object.entries(request.query).every(
					([key, value]) =>
						!value || String(Reflect.get(row, key) ?? '').includes(String(value))
				)
			);
			return {
				list: filtered
					.slice(
						(request.currentPage - 1) * request.pageSize,
						request.currentPage * request.pageSize
					)
					.map((row) => ({ ...copy(row), id: row.id, version: row.version })),
				total: filtered.length
			};
		},
		async defaults() {
			return defaults();
		},
		async load(key) {
			const row = rows.get(key);
			if (!row) throw new Error('项目已不存在');
			return copy(row);
		},
		async create(model, operation) {
			const id = ++sequence;
			rows.set(id, {
				...copy(model),
				id,
				version: 1,
				reference: `PRJ-2026-${String(id).padStart(3, '0')}`
			});
			applied.add(operation.target.operationId);
			return { status: 'success' };
		},
		async update(key, model, operation) {
			const row = rows.get(key);
			if (!row) return { status: 'failure', message: '项目已不存在' };
			rows.set(key, { ...copy(model), id: key, version: row.version + 1 });
			applied.add(operation.target.operationId);
			return { status: 'success' };
		},
		async verify(operation) {
			return {
				status: applied.has(operation.target.operationId) ? 'success' : 'not-applied'
			};
		},
		async resolve(keys) {
			return keys.map((key) => {
				const row = rows.get(key);
				return row
					? {
							key,
							target: {
								key,
								version: String(row.version),
								payload: { name: row.name }
							}
						}
					: { key, reason: '项目已不存在' };
			});
		},
		async remove(target) {
			rows.delete(target.key);
			return { key: target.key, status: 'success' };
		},
		async verifyRemove(target) {
			return { key: target.key, status: rows.has(target.key) ? 'unsent' : 'success' };
		}
	};
	return {
		services,
		async detail(key: string | number) {
			const row = rows.get(key);
			return row
				? { status: 'ready' as const, data: { ...copy(row) } }
				: { status: 'missing' as const };
		},
		complete(keys: readonly (string | number)[]) {
			for (const key of keys) {
				const row = rows.get(key);
				if (row) rows.set(key, { ...row, status: '已完成', progress: 100 });
			}
		}
	};
}

import {

interface BaseEdit {

	team: string;
	status: string;
	owner: string;
	email: string;
	note: string;
}
interface BaseRow extends BaseEdit {

}
const baseCodec: AsamCrudCodec<BaseEdit> = {
	encode: (model) => ({ ...model }),

			const value = model[key];
			if (typeof value !== 'string') throw new TypeError(`字段${key}必须为string`);
			return value;
		};
		return {
			name: text('name'),
			team: text('team'),
			status: text('status'),
			owner: text('owner'),
			email: text('email'),
			note: text('note')
		};
	}
};
export interface ExtraFields {

	category: string;
	region: string | null;
	priority: string;
	startDate: string | null;
	dueDate: string | null;

const defaults = (): ExtraFields => ({
	reference: 'LOCAL-DEMO',
	category: '组件演示',
	region: null,
	priority: '中',
	startDate: '',
	dueDate: '',
	budget: 0,
	progress: 0,
	channels: [],
	enabled: false,
	tags: [],
	time: '09:00',
	attachments: []
});
const string = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string';
const strings = (v: unknown): v is string[] => Array.isArray(v) && v.every(string);
const finite = (v: unknown): v is number => typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v);

	return (
		Array.isArray(v) &&

			(r: unknown) =>
				!!r &&
				typeof r === 'object' &&
				typeof Reflect.get(r, 'id') === 'string' &&
				typeof Reflect.get(r, 'name') === 'string' &&
				typeof Reflect.get(r, 'url') === 'string' &&
				typeof Reflect.get(r, 'mimeType') === 'string' &&
				finite(Reflect.get(r, 'size')) &&
				Reflect.get(r, 'size') >= 0

}
function extras(model: object): ExtraFields {
	const result = defaults();
	for (const key of ['reference', 'category', 'priority'] as const) {
		const value: unknown = Reflect.get(model, key);
		if (value !== undefined) {
			if (!string(value)) throw new TypeError(key);
			result[key] = value;
		}
	}
	for (const key of ['region', 'startDate', 'dueDate', 'time'] as const) {
		const value: unknown = Reflect.get(model, key);
		if (value !== undefined) {
			if (value !== null && !string(value)) throw new TypeError(key);
			result[key] = value;

	for (const key of ['budget', 'progress'] as const) {
		const value: unknown = Reflect.get(model, key);
		if (value !== undefined) {

			result[key] = value;
		}

	for (const key of ['channels', 'tags'] as const) {
		const value: unknown = Reflect.get(model, key);
		if (value !== undefined) {

			result[key] = [...value];

	if (enabled !== undefined) {
		if (typeof enabled !== 'boolean') throw new TypeError('enabled');
		result.enabled = enabled;
	}
	const files: unknown = Reflect.get(model, 'attachments');
	if (files !== undefined) {
		if (!resources(files)) throw new TypeError('attachments');
		result.attachments = files.map((file) => ({ ...file }));

}
export const richCodec: AsamCrudCodec<RichEdit> = {
	encode: (model) => ({

		tags: [...model.tags],

const source = (values: readonly string[]) =>
	defineAsamOptions().static({ options: values.map((value) => ({ value, label: value })) });

function equalTags(a: unknown, b: unknown): boolean {

	return (

		resources(b) &&

		a.every((file, i) => {
			const other = b[i]!;
			return (
				file.id === other.id &&
				file.name === other.name &&
				file.url === other.url &&
				file.mimeType === other.mimeType &&
				file.size === other.size
			);
		})
	);

	region: Object.is,
	startDate: Object.is,
	dueDate: Object.is,
	budget: Object.is,
	progress: Object.is,
	enabled: Object.is,
	tags: equalTags,
	time: Object.is,
	attachments: equalAttachments
});

<template>
	<AsamUpload
		:model-value="modelValue"
		multiple
		:upload="upload"
		:disabled="disabled"
		drag
		@update:model-value="update"
	>
		<p>选择或拖入演示附件</p>
		<template #tip>本地合成上传，不连接真实服务。</template>
	</AsamUpload>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { AsamUpload } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamUploadedResource, AsamUploadHandler, AsamUploadValue } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineProps<{ modelValue: readonly AsamUploadedResource[]; disabled?: boolean }>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ 'update:modelValue': [value: AsamUploadedResource[]] }>();
const upload: AsamUploadHandler = async ({ file }, context) => {
	context.reportProgress({ loaded: file.size / 2, total: file.size });
	await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 80));
	if (context.signal.aborted) throw new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError');
	context.reportProgress({ loaded: file.size, total: file.size });
	return {
		id: 'demo-' + file.name + '-' + file.size,
		name: file.name,
		url: '/__local-preview__/' + encodeURIComponent(file.name),
		size: file.size,
		mimeType: file.type || 'application/octet-stream'
	};
};
function update(value: AsamUploadValue) {
	if (Array.isArray(value)) emit('update:modelValue', [...value]);
}
</script>

import { defineAsamOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { richCodec, richEquals, richFields } from './RichFields.js';
export const initialProjectQuery = {
	name: '',
	owner: null,
	status: null,
	reference: '',
	dueDate: null,
	priority: null
};
export const owners = ['陈晨', '林悦', '张远', '许宁', '周可', '沈知'];
export const statuses = ['进行中', '待启动', '已完成', '已暂停'];
const names = [
	'华东供应链协同平台',
	'园区设备巡检',
	'研发知识库升级',
	'客户服务工作台',
	'渠道结算自动化',
	'华南仓储可视化',
	'数据治理与指标口径统一',
	'生产计划排程',
	'质量追溯系统',
	'移动审批助手',
	'合同归档与检索',
	'团队协作空间'
];

	defineAsamOptions().static({ options: values.map((value) => ({ value, label: value })) });

	key,

	source: source(values),
	adaptInput: (value) => {

			typeof value === 'boolean' ||

		)
			return value;
		throw new TypeError('选择值必须是合法标量或空值');
	},
	query: (value) => value ?? '',
	modes: { query: { componentProps: { placeholder: '全部', clearable: true } } }

		label: '项目名称',
		kind: 'text',
		modes: { query: { componentProps: { placeholder: '输入项目名称', clearable: true } } }
	},
	choice('owner', '负责人', owners),
	choice('status', '项目状态', statuses),
	{
		key: 'reference',
		label: '项目编号',
		kind: 'text',
		modes: { query: { componentProps: { placeholder: '如 PRJ-2026-001', clearable: true } } }
	},
	{

		modes: {
			query: {
				componentProps: {
					valueFormat: 'YYYY-MM-DD',
					placeholder: '选择日期',
					clearable: true
				}
			}
		}
	},
	choice('priority', '优先级', ['高', '中', '低'])

export function createProjectMock(empty = false) {
	const rows = new Map();
	if (!empty)
		for (let index = 0; index < 24; index++) {
			const id = index + 1;
			rows.set(id, {
				...defaults(),
				id,
				version: 1,
				name: names[index % names.length] + (index >= names.length ? ' · 二期' : ''),
				reference: `PRJ-2026-${String(id).padStart(3, '0')}`,
				owner: owners[index % owners.length],
				status: statuses[[0, 1, 0, 2, 3, 0][index % 6]],
				startDate: '2026-10-01',
				dueDate: `2026-11-${String(5 + index).padStart(2, '0')}`,
				priority: index % 3 ? '中' : '高',
				budget: 48000 + index * 3200,
				progress: [68, 0, 42, 100, 35, 76][index % 6],
				tags: ['重点项目', '跨团队'],
				attachments: [
					{
						id: `project-spec-${id}`,
						name: '项目交付清单与里程碑计划.pdf',
						url: `/__mock-project-documents__/${id}`,
						mimeType: 'application/pdf',
						size: 1887437
					}
				],
				note: '统一项目计划、交付资料与跨团队协作。当前里程碑为完成核心流程联调，下一阶段进入使用反馈与体验优化。'
			});
		}
	let sequence = 100;
	const applied = new Set();
	const services = {
		async list(request) {
			const filtered = [...rows.values()].filter((row) =>
				Object.entries(request.query).every(
					([key, value]) =>
						!value || String(Reflect.get(row, key) ?? '').includes(String(value))
				)
			);
			return {
				list: filtered
					.slice(
						(request.currentPage - 1) * request.pageSize,
						request.currentPage * request.pageSize
					)
					.map((row) => ({ ...copy(row), id: row.id, version: row.version })),
				total: filtered.length
			};
		},
		async defaults() {
			return defaults();
		},
		async load(key) {
			const row = rows.get(key);
			if (!row) throw new Error('项目已不存在');
			return copy(row);
		},
		async create(model, operation) {
			const id = ++sequence;
			rows.set(id, {
				...copy(model),
				id,
				version: 1,
				reference: `PRJ-2026-${String(id).padStart(3, '0')}`
			});
			applied.add(operation.target.operationId);
			return { status: 'success' };
		},
		async update(key, model, operation) {
			const row = rows.get(key);
			if (!row) return { status: 'failure', message: '项目已不存在' };
			rows.set(key, { ...copy(model), id: key, version: row.version + 1 });
			applied.add(operation.target.operationId);
			return { status: 'success' };
		},
		async verify(operation) {
			return {
				status: applied.has(operation.target.operationId) ? 'success' : 'not-applied'
			};
		},
		async resolve(keys) {
			return keys.map((key) => {
				const row = rows.get(key);
				return row
					? {
							key,
							target: {
								key,
								version: String(row.version),
								payload: { name: row.name }
							}
						}
					: { key, reason: '项目已不存在' };
			});
		},
		async remove(target) {
			rows.delete(target.key);
			return { key: target.key, status: 'success' };
		},
		async verifyRemove(target) {
			return { key: target.key, status: rows.has(target.key) ? 'unsent' : 'success' };
		}
	};
	return {
		services,
		async detail(key) {
			const row = rows.get(key);
			return row ? { status: 'ready', data: { ...copy(row) } } : { status: 'missing' };
		},
		complete(keys) {
			for (const key of keys) {
				const row = rows.get(key);
				if (row) rows.set(key, { ...row, status: '已完成', progress: 100 });
			}
		}
	};
}

<template>
	<AsamUpload
		:model-value="modelValue"
		multiple
		:upload="upload"
		:disabled="disabled"
		drag
		@update:model-value="update"
	>
		<p>选择或拖入演示附件</p>
		<template #tip>本地合成上传，不连接真实服务。</template>
	</AsamUpload>
</template>
<script setup>
import { AsamUpload } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineProps({
	modelValue: { type: Array, required: true },
	disabled: { type: Boolean, required: false }
});
const emit = defineEmits(['update:modelValue']);
const upload = async ({ file }, context) => {
	context.reportProgress({ loaded: file.size / 2, total: file.size });
	await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 80));
	if (context.signal.aborted) throw new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError');
	context.reportProgress({ loaded: file.size, total: file.size });
	return {
		id: 'demo-' + file.name + '-' + file.size,
		name: file.name,
		url: '/__local-preview__/' + encodeURIComponent(file.name),
		size: file.size,
		mimeType: file.type || 'application/octet-stream'
	};
};
function update(value) {
	if (Array.isArray(value)) emit('update:modelValue', [...value]);
}
</script>

import type { AsamCrudCodec, AsamCrudServices } from '@asam-ui/pro/templates/crud';
import type { AsamFieldDefinition } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { defineAsamOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamOption } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { richCodec, richEquals, richFields } from './RichFields.js';
import type { RichEdit, RichRow } from './RichFields.js';

export interface ProjectQuery {

	owner: string | null;
	status: string | null;
	reference: string;
	dueDate: string | null;
	priority: string | null;
}
export const initialProjectQuery: ProjectQuery = {
	name: '',
	owner: null,
	status: null,
	reference: '',
	dueDate: null,
	priority: null
};
export const owners = ['陈晨', '林悦', '张远', '许宁', '周可', '沈知'];
export const statuses = ['进行中', '待启动', '已完成', '已暂停'];
const names = [
	'华东供应链协同平台',
	'园区设备巡检',
	'研发知识库升级',
	'客户服务工作台',
	'渠道结算自动化',
	'华南仓储可视化',
	'数据治理与指标口径统一',
	'生产计划排程',
	'质量追溯系统',
	'移动审批助手',
	'合同归档与检索',
	'团队协作空间'
];
const source = (values: readonly string[]) =>
	defineAsamOptions().static({ options: values.map((value) => ({ value, label: value })) });
const choice = (key: string, label: string, values: readonly string[]): AsamFieldDefinition => ({
	key,
	label,
	kind: 'single',
	source: source(values),
	adaptInput: (value) => {
		if (value === '' || value === null || value === undefined) return null;
		if (
			typeof value === 'string' ||
			typeof value === 'boolean' ||
			(typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value))
		)
			return value;
		throw new TypeError('选择值必须是合法标量或空值');
	},
	query: (value) => value ?? '',
	modes: { query: { componentProps: { placeholder: '全部', clearable: true } } }
});
export const projectQueryFields: readonly AsamFieldDefinition[] = [
	{
		key: 'name',
		label: '项目名称',
		kind: 'text',
		modes: { query: { componentProps: { placeholder: '输入项目名称', clearable: true } } }
	},
	choice('owner', '负责人', owners),
	choice('status', '项目状态', statuses),
	{
		key: 'reference',
		label: '项目编号',
		kind: 'text',
		modes: { query: { componentProps: { placeholder: '如 PRJ-2026-001', clearable: true } } }
	},
	{
		...richFields.find((field) => field.key === 'dueDate')!,
		modes: {
			query: {
				componentProps: {
					valueFormat: 'YYYY-MM-DD',
					placeholder: '选择日期',
					clearable: true
				}
			}
		}
	},
	choice('priority', '优先级', ['高', '中', '低'])
];
export const projectQueryCodec: AsamCrudCodec<ProjectQuery> = {
	encode: (model) => ({
		...model,
		owner: model.owner || null,
		status: model.status || null,
		priority: model.priority || null
	}),
	decode: (model) => {
		const text = (key: string) => {
			const value = model[key];
			if (value === null || value === undefined) return '';
			if (typeof value !== 'string') throw new TypeError(key);
			return value;
		};
		return {
			name: text('name'),
			owner: text('owner') || null,
			status: text('status') || null,
			reference: text('reference'),
			dueDate: model.dueDate === null ? null : text('dueDate'),
			priority: text('priority') || null
		};
	}
};
const labels: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = {
	name: '项目名称',
	reference: '项目编号',
	category: '项目类型',
	team: '所属团队',
	region: '所属区域',
	status: '项目状态',
	budget: '预算（元）',
	progress: '完成进度',
	channels: '通知渠道',
	enabled: '截止提醒',
	tags: '项目标签',
	time: '提醒时间',
	attachments: '交付附件',
	note: '项目说明'
};
const fieldOrder = [
	'name',
	'reference',
	'category',
	'owner',
	'team',
	'region',
	'status',
	'priority',
	'startDate',
	'dueDate',
	'budget',
	'progress',
	'channels',
	'enabled',
	'tags',
	'time',
	'email',
	'attachments',
	'note'
];
// JS 投影也保留返回类型，避免嵌套字段模式推导成庞大联合。
const definitions = fieldOrder.map(
	/** @returns {import('@asam-ui/pro').AsamFieldDefinition} */ (key): AsamFieldDefinition => {
		const field = richFields.find((item) => item.key === key)!;
		const label = labels[field.key] ?? field.label;
		const group = ['name', 'reference', 'category', 'owner', 'team', 'region'].includes(
			field.key
		)
			? '基本信息'
			: ['status', 'priority', 'startDate', 'dueDate', 'budget', 'progress'].includes(
						field.key
				  )
				? '计划安排'
				: ['attachments', 'note'].includes(field.key)
					? '附件与说明'
					: '协作设置';
		const layout = { ...field.modes?.edit?.layout, group };
		const modes = {
			...field.modes,
			edit: { ...field.modes?.edit, layout },
			detail: { ...field.modes?.detail, layout }
		};
		if (field.key === 'email')
			return {
				...field,
				label,
				submitHidden: true,
				submit: (value: unknown) => value,
				modes: {
					...modes,
					edit: { ...modes.edit, hidden: true },
					detail: { ...modes.detail, hidden: true }
				}
			};
		if (field.key === 'region')
			return {
				...field,
				label,
				format: (value: unknown) =>
					value === 'hz' ? '中国 / 浙江 / 杭州' : String(value ?? '—'),
				modes: {
					...modes,
					edit: {
						...modes.edit,
						componentProps: {
							props: { emitPath: false },
							placeholder: '请选择区域',
							options: [
								{
									value: 'cn',
									label: '中国',
									raw: { code: 'cn' },
									children: [
										{
											value: 'zj',
											label: '浙江',
											raw: { code: 'zj' },
											children: [
												{ value: 'hz', label: '杭州', raw: { code: 'hz' } }
											]
										}
									]
								}
							] satisfies readonly AsamOption<string, { code: string }>[]
						}
					}
				}
			};
		if (field.key === 'reference')
			return {
				...field,
				label,
				modes: {
					...modes,
					edit: { ...modes.edit, readonly: false, componentProps: { readonly: true } }
				}
			};
		if (field.key === 'name' || field.key === 'owner')
			return {
				...field,
				label,
				modes: {
					...modes,
					edit: {
						...modes.edit,
						componentProps: {
							placeholder:
								field.key === 'name' ? '请输入项目名称' : '输入或选择负责人'
						}
					}
				}
			};
		if (field.key === 'progress')
			return {
				...field,
				label,
				format: (value: unknown) => `${String(value)}%`,
				modes: {
					...modes,
					edit: {
						...modes.edit,
						componentProps: { ...modes.edit.componentProps, showInput: true }
					}
				}
			};
		if (field.key === 'enabled')
			return {
				...field,
				label: '截止提醒',
				format: (value: unknown) => (value ? '开启' : '关闭'),
				modes: {
					...modes,
					edit: {
						...modes.edit,
						componentProps: { activeText: '已开启', inactiveText: '已关闭' }
					}
				}
			};
		if (field.key === 'tags' || field.key === 'note')
			return {
				...field,
				label,
				modes: {
					...modes,
					edit: {
						...modes.edit,
						componentProps: {
							...modes.edit.componentProps,
							placeholder:
								field.key === 'tags'
									? '输入后按 Enter 添加'
									: '填写目标、交付范围或协作事项',
							...(field.key === 'note' ? { rows: 3 } : {})
						}
					}
				}
			};
		if (field.kind === 'single') {
			const values =
				field.key === 'status'
					? statuses
					: field.key === 'category'
						? ['平台建设', '流程优化', '数据分析']
						: field.key === 'team'
							? ['平台研发组', '客户体验组', '运营协作组']
							: undefined;
			if (values)
				return { ...field, label, source: source(values), control: 'select', modes };
		}
		return { ...field, label, modes };
	}
);
export const projectFields = definitions;
export const projectEditorConfig = {
	editFields: projectFields,
	detailFields: projectFields,
	editCodec: richCodec,
	equals: richEquals
};
function copy(model: RichEdit): RichEdit {
	return richCodec.decode(richCodec.encode(model));
}
function defaults(): RichEdit {
	return richCodec.decode({
		name: '',
		reference: '保存后自动生成',
		owner: '',
		team: '平台研发组',
		category: '平台建设',
		region: 'hz',
		status: '待启动',
		email: '',
		note: '',
		startDate: '2026-10-30',
		dueDate: '2026-11-30',
		priority: '中',
		budget: 0,
		progress: 0
	});
}
/** 仅视觉演示内存服务；控制器、校验和写入入口仍消费正常公共包。 */
export function createProjectMock(empty = false) {
	const rows = new Map<string | number, RichRow>();
	if (!empty)
		for (let index = 0; index < 24; index++) {
			const id = index + 1;
			rows.set(id, {
				...defaults(),
				id,
				version: 1,
				name: names[index % names.length]! + (index >= names.length ? ' · 二期' : ''),
				reference: `PRJ-2026-${String(id).padStart(3, '0')}`,
				owner: owners[index % owners.length]!,
				status: statuses[[0, 1, 0, 2, 3, 0][index % 6]!]!,
				startDate: '2026-10-01',
				dueDate: `2026-11-${String(5 + index).padStart(2, '0')}`,
				priority: index % 3 ? '中' : '高',
				budget: 48000 + index * 3200,
				progress: [68, 0, 42, 100, 35, 76][index % 6]!,
				tags: ['重点项目', '跨团队'],
				attachments: [
					{
						id: `project-spec-${id}`,
						name: '项目交付清单与里程碑计划.pdf',
						url: `/__mock-project-documents__/${id}`,
						mimeType: 'application/pdf',
						size: 1887437
					}
				],
				note: '统一项目计划、交付资料与跨团队协作。当前里程碑为完成核心流程联调，下一阶段进入使用反馈与体验优化。'
			});
		}
	let sequence = 100;
	const applied = new Set<string>();
	const services: AsamCrudServices<RichRow, ProjectQuery, RichEdit, string | number> = {
		async list(request) {
			const filtered = [...rows.values()].filter((row) =>
				Object.entries(request.query).every(
					([key, value]) =>
						!value || String(Reflect.get(row, key) ?? '').includes(String(value))
				)
			);
			return {
				list: filtered
					.slice(
						(request.currentPage - 1) * request.pageSize,
						request.currentPage * request.pageSize
					)
					.map((row) => ({ ...copy(row), id: row.id, version: row.version })),
				total: filtered.length
			};
		},
		async defaults() {
			return defaults();
		},
		async load(key) {
			const row = rows.get(key);
			if (!row) throw new Error('项目已不存在');
			return copy(row);
		},
		async create(model, operation) {
			const id = ++sequence;
			rows.set(id, {
				...copy(model),
				id,
				version: 1,
				reference: `PRJ-2026-${String(id).padStart(3, '0')}`
			});
			applied.add(operation.target.operationId);
			return { status: 'success' };
		},
		async update(key, model, operation) {
			const row = rows.get(key);
			if (!row) return { status: 'failure', message: '项目已不存在' };
			rows.set(key, { ...copy(model), id: key, version: row.version + 1 });
			applied.add(operation.target.operationId);
			return { status: 'success' };
		},
		async verify(operation) {
			return {
				status: applied.has(operation.target.operationId) ? 'success' : 'not-applied'
			};
		},
		async resolve(keys) {
			return keys.map((key) => {
				const row = rows.get(key);
				return row
					? {
							key,
							target: {
								key,
								version: String(row.version),
								payload: { name: row.name }
							}
						}
					: { key, reason: '项目已不存在' };
			});
		},
		async remove(target) {
			rows.delete(target.key);
			return { key: target.key, status: 'success' };
		},
		async verifyRemove(target) {
			return { key: target.key, status: rows.has(target.key) ? 'unsent' : 'success' };
		}
	};
	return {
		services,
		async detail(key: string | number) {
			const row = rows.get(key);
			return row
				? { status: 'ready' as const, data: { ...copy(row) } }
				: { status: 'missing' as const };
		},
		complete(keys: readonly (string | number)[]) {
			for (const key of keys) {
				const row = rows.get(key);
				if (row) rows.set(key, { ...row, status: '已完成', progress: 100 });
			}
		}
	};
}

import {
	AsamCascader,
	AsamDatePicker,
	AsamInputNumber,
	AsamInputTag,
	AsamSlider,
	AsamSwitch,
	AsamTimePicker,
	defineAsamControl,
	defineAsamOptions
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamUploadedResource } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamCrudCodec } from '@asam-ui/pro/templates/crud';
import type { AsamFieldDefinition } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import UploadField from './UploadField.vue';
interface BaseEdit {
	name: string;
	team: string;
	status: string;
	owner: string;
	email: string;
	note: string;
}
interface BaseRow extends BaseEdit {
	id: string | number;
	version: number;
}
const baseCodec: AsamCrudCodec<BaseEdit> = {
	encode: (model) => ({ ...model }),
	decode: (model) => {
		const text = (key: keyof BaseEdit) => {
			const value = model[key];
			if (typeof value !== 'string') throw new TypeError(`字段${key}必须为string`);
			return value;
		};
		return {
			name: text('name'),
			team: text('team'),
			status: text('status'),
			owner: text('owner'),
			email: text('email'),
			note: text('note')
		};
	}
};
export interface ExtraFields {
	reference: string;
	category: string;
	region: string | null;
	priority: string;
	startDate: string | null;
	dueDate: string | null;
	budget: number;
	progress: number;
	channels: string[];
	enabled: boolean;
	tags: string[];
	time: string | null;
	attachments: AsamUploadedResource[];
}
export type RichRow = BaseRow & ExtraFields;
export type RichEdit = BaseEdit & ExtraFields;
const defaults = (): ExtraFields => ({
	reference: 'LOCAL-DEMO',
	category: '组件演示',
	region: null,
	priority: '中',
	startDate: '',
	dueDate: '',
	budget: 0,
	progress: 0,
	channels: [],
	enabled: false,
	tags: [],
	time: '09:00',
	attachments: []
});
const string = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string';
const strings = (v: unknown): v is string[] => Array.isArray(v) && v.every(string);
const finite = (v: unknown): v is number => typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v);
function resources(v: unknown): v is AsamUploadedResource[] {
	return (
		Array.isArray(v) &&
		v.every(
			(r: unknown) =>
				!!r &&
				typeof r === 'object' &&
				typeof Reflect.get(r, 'id') === 'string' &&
				typeof Reflect.get(r, 'name') === 'string' &&
				typeof Reflect.get(r, 'url') === 'string' &&
				typeof Reflect.get(r, 'mimeType') === 'string' &&
				finite(Reflect.get(r, 'size')) &&
				Reflect.get(r, 'size') >= 0
		)
	);
}
function extras(model: object): ExtraFields {
	const result = defaults();
	for (const key of ['reference', 'category', 'priority'] as const) {
		const value: unknown = Reflect.get(model, key);
		if (value !== undefined) {
			if (!string(value)) throw new TypeError(key);
			result[key] = value;
		}
	}
	for (const key of ['region', 'startDate', 'dueDate', 'time'] as const) {
		const value: unknown = Reflect.get(model, key);
		if (value !== undefined) {
			if (value !== null && !string(value)) throw new TypeError(key);
			result[key] = value;
		}
	}
	for (const key of ['budget', 'progress'] as const) {
		const value: unknown = Reflect.get(model, key);
		if (value !== undefined) {
			if (!finite(value)) throw new TypeError(key);
			result[key] = value;
		}
	}
	for (const key of ['channels', 'tags'] as const) {
		const value: unknown = Reflect.get(model, key);
		if (value !== undefined) {
			if (!strings(value)) throw new TypeError(key);
			result[key] = [...value];
		}
	}
	const enabled: unknown = Reflect.get(model, 'enabled');
	if (enabled !== undefined) {
		if (typeof enabled !== 'boolean') throw new TypeError('enabled');
		result.enabled = enabled;
	}
	const files: unknown = Reflect.get(model, 'attachments');
	if (files !== undefined) {
		if (!resources(files)) throw new TypeError('attachments');
		result.attachments = files.map((file) => ({ ...file }));
	}
	return result;

	return strings(a) && strings(b) && a.length === b.length && a.every((tag, i) => tag === b[i]);

function equalAttachments(a: unknown, b: unknown): boolean {
	return (
		resources(a) &&
		resources(b) &&
		a.length === b.length &&
		a.every((file, i) => {
			const other = b[i]!;
			return (
				file.id === other.id &&
				file.name === other.name &&
				file.url === other.url &&
				file.mimeType === other.mimeType &&
				file.size === other.size
			);
		})
	);
}

	startDate: Object.is,
	dueDate: Object.is,
	budget: Object.is,
	progress: Object.is,
	enabled: Object.is,
	tags: equalTags,
	time: Object.is,
	attachments: equalAttachments
});

<template>

		:model-value="modelValue"
		multiple
		:upload="upload"
		:disabled="disabled"
		drag
		@update:model-value="update"
	>
		<p>选择或拖入演示附件</p>
		<template #tip>本地合成上传，不连接真实服务。</template>
	</AsamUpload>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { AsamUpload } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamUploadedResource, AsamUploadHandler, AsamUploadValue } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineProps<{ modelValue: readonly AsamUploadedResource[]; disabled?: boolean }>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ 'update:modelValue': [value: AsamUploadedResource[]] }>();
const upload: AsamUploadHandler = async ({ file }, context) => {
	context.reportProgress({ loaded: file.size / 2, total: file.size });
	await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 80));
	if (context.signal.aborted) throw new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError');
	context.reportProgress({ loaded: file.size, total: file.size });
	return {
		id: 'demo-' + file.name + '-' + file.size,
		name: file.name,
		url: '/__local-preview__/' + encodeURIComponent(file.name),
		size: file.size,
		mimeType: file.type || 'application/octet-stream'
	};
};
function update(value: AsamUploadValue) {
	if (Array.isArray(value)) emit('update:modelValue', [...value]);
}
</script>

/** 仅视觉演示内存服务；控制器、校验和写入入口仍消费正常公共包。 */
export function createProjectMock(empty = false) {
	const rows = new Map();
	if (!empty)
		for (let index = 0; index < 24; index++) {
			const id = index + 1;
			rows.set(id, {
				...defaults(),
				id,
				version: 1,
				name: names[index % names.length] + (index >= names.length ? ' · 二期' : ''),
				reference: `PRJ-2026-${String(id).padStart(3, '0')}`,
				owner: owners[index % owners.length],
				status: statuses[[0, 1, 0, 2, 3, 0][index % 6]],
				startDate: '2026-10-01',
				dueDate: `2026-11-${String(5 + index).padStart(2, '0')}`,
				priority: index % 3 ? '中' : '高',
				budget: 48000 + index * 3200,
				progress: [68, 0, 42, 100, 35, 76][index % 6],
				tags: ['重点项目', '跨团队'],
				attachments: [
					{
						id: `project-spec-${id}`,
						name: '项目交付清单与里程碑计划.pdf',
						url: `/__mock-project-documents__/${id}`,
						mimeType: 'application/pdf',
						size: 1887437
					}
				],
				note: '统一项目计划、交付资料与跨团队协作。当前里程碑为完成核心流程联调，下一阶段进入使用反馈与体验优化。'
			});
		}
	let sequence = 100;
	const applied = new Set();
	const services = {
		async list(request) {
			const filtered = [...rows.values()].filter((row) =>
				Object.entries(request.query).every(
					([key, value]) =>
						!value || String(Reflect.get(row, key) ?? '').includes(String(value))
				)
			);
			return {
				list: filtered
					.slice(
						(request.currentPage - 1) * request.pageSize,
						request.currentPage * request.pageSize
					)
					.map((row) => ({ ...copy(row), id: row.id, version: row.version })),
				total: filtered.length
			};
		},
		async defaults() {
			return defaults();
		},
		async load(key) {
			const row = rows.get(key);
			if (!row) throw new Error('项目已不存在');
			return copy(row);
		},
		async create(model, operation) {
			const id = ++sequence;
			rows.set(id, {
				...copy(model),
				id,
				version: 1,
				reference: `PRJ-2026-${String(id).padStart(3, '0')}`
			});
			applied.add(operation.target.operationId);
			return { status: 'success' };
		},
		async update(key, model, operation) {
			const row = rows.get(key);
			if (!row) return { status: 'failure', message: '项目已不存在' };
			rows.set(key, { ...copy(model), id: key, version: row.version + 1 });
			applied.add(operation.target.operationId);
			return { status: 'success' };
		},
		async verify(operation) {
			return {
				status: applied.has(operation.target.operationId) ? 'success' : 'not-applied'
			};
		},
		async resolve(keys) {
			return keys.map((key) => {
				const row = rows.get(key);
				return row
					? {
							key,
							target: {
								key,
								version: String(row.version),
								payload: { name: row.name }
							}
						}
					: { key, reason: '项目已不存在' };
			});
		},
		async remove(target) {
			rows.delete(target.key);
			return { key: target.key, status: 'success' };
		},
		async verifyRemove(target) {
			return { key: target.key, status: rows.has(target.key) ? 'unsent' : 'success' };
		}
	};
	return {
		services,
		async detail(key) {
			const row = rows.get(key);
			return row ? { status: 'ready', data: { ...copy(row) } } : { status: 'missing' };
		},
		complete(keys) {
			for (const key of keys) {
				const row = rows.get(key);
				if (row) rows.set(key, { ...row, status: '已完成', progress: 100 });
			}
		}
	};
}

		:model-value="modelValue"
		multiple
		:upload="upload"
		:disabled="disabled"
		drag
		@update:model-value="update"
	>

<script setup>
import { AsamUpload } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineProps({
	modelValue: { type: Array, required: true },
	disabled: { type: Boolean, required: false }
});
const emit = defineEmits(['update:modelValue']);
const upload = async ({ file }, context) => {
	context.reportProgress({ loaded: file.size / 2, total: file.size });
	await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 80));
	if (context.signal.aborted) throw new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError');
	context.reportProgress({ loaded: file.size, total: file.size });
	return {
		id: 'demo-' + file.name + '-' + file.size,
		name: file.name,
		url: '/__local-preview__/' + encodeURIComponent(file.name),
		size: file.size,
		mimeType: file.type || 'application/octet-stream'
	};
};
function update(value) {
	if (Array.isArray(value)) emit('update:modelValue', [...value]);
}
</script>

import type { AsamCrudCodec, AsamCrudServices } from '@asam-ui/pro/templates/crud';

/** 仅视觉演示内存服务；控制器、校验和写入入口仍消费正常公共包。 */
export function createProjectMock(empty = false) {
	const rows = new Map<string | number, RichRow>();
	if (!empty)
		for (let index = 0; index < 24; index++) {
			const id = index + 1;
			rows.set(id, {
				...defaults(),
				id,
				version: 1,
				name: names[index % names.length]! + (index >= names.length ? ' · 二期' : ''),
				reference: `PRJ-2026-${String(id).padStart(3, '0')}`,
				owner: owners[index % owners.length]!,
				status: statuses[[0, 1, 0, 2, 3, 0][index % 6]!]!,
				startDate: '2026-10-01',
				dueDate: `2026-11-${String(5 + index).padStart(2, '0')}`,
				priority: index % 3 ? '中' : '高',
				budget: 48000 + index * 3200,
				progress: [68, 0, 42, 100, 35, 76][index % 6]!,
				tags: ['重点项目', '跨团队'],
				attachments: [
					{
						id: `project-spec-${id}`,
						name: '项目交付清单与里程碑计划.pdf',
						url: `/__mock-project-documents__/${id}`,
						mimeType: 'application/pdf',
						size: 1887437
					}
				],
				note: '统一项目计划、交付资料与跨团队协作。当前里程碑为完成核心流程联调，下一阶段进入使用反馈与体验优化。'
			});
		}
	let sequence = 100;
	const applied = new Set<string>();
	const services: AsamCrudServices<RichRow, ProjectQuery, RichEdit, string | number> = {
		async list(request) {
			const filtered = [...rows.values()].filter((row) =>
				Object.entries(request.query).every(
					([key, value]) =>
						!value || String(Reflect.get(row, key) ?? '').includes(String(value))
				)
			);
			return {
				list: filtered
					.slice(
						(request.currentPage - 1) * request.pageSize,
						request.currentPage * request.pageSize
					)
					.map((row) => ({ ...copy(row), id: row.id, version: row.version })),
				total: filtered.length
			};
		},
		async defaults() {
			return defaults();
		},
		async load(key) {
			const row = rows.get(key);
			if (!row) throw new Error('项目已不存在');
			return copy(row);
		},
		async create(model, operation) {
			const id = ++sequence;
			rows.set(id, {
				...copy(model),
				id,
				version: 1,
				reference: `PRJ-2026-${String(id).padStart(3, '0')}`
			});
			applied.add(operation.target.operationId);
			return { status: 'success' };
		},
		async update(key, model, operation) {
			const row = rows.get(key);
			if (!row) return { status: 'failure', message: '项目已不存在' };
			rows.set(key, { ...copy(model), id: key, version: row.version + 1 });
			applied.add(operation.target.operationId);
			return { status: 'success' };
		},
		async verify(operation) {
			return {
				status: applied.has(operation.target.operationId) ? 'success' : 'not-applied'
			};
		},
		async resolve(keys) {
			return keys.map((key) => {
				const row = rows.get(key);
				return row
					? {
							key,
							target: {
								key,
								version: String(row.version),
								payload: { name: row.name }
							}
						}
					: { key, reason: '项目已不存在' };
			});
		},
		async remove(target) {
			rows.delete(target.key);
			return { key: target.key, status: 'success' };
		},
		async verifyRemove(target) {
			return { key: target.key, status: rows.has(target.key) ? 'unsent' : 'success' };
		}
	};
	return {
		services,
		async detail(key: string | number) {
			const row = rows.get(key);
			return row
				? { status: 'ready' as const, data: { ...copy(row) } }
				: { status: 'missing' as const };
		},
		complete(keys: readonly (string | number)[]) {
			for (const key of keys) {
				const row = rows.get(key);
				if (row) rows.set(key, { ...row, status: '已完成', progress: 100 });
			}
		}
	};
}

import {
	AsamCascader,
	AsamDatePicker,
	AsamInputNumber,
	AsamInputTag,
	AsamSlider,
	AsamSwitch,
	AsamTimePicker,
	defineAsamControl,
	defineAsamOptions
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamUploadedResource } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamCrudCodec } from '@asam-ui/pro/templates/crud';
import type { AsamFieldDefinition } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import UploadField from './UploadField.vue';
interface BaseEdit {
	name: string;
	team: string;
	status: string;
	owner: string;
	email: string;
	note: string;
}
interface BaseRow extends BaseEdit {
	id: string | number;
	version: number;
}
const baseCodec: AsamCrudCodec<BaseEdit> = {
	encode: (model) => ({ ...model }),
	decode: (model) => {
		const text = (key: keyof BaseEdit) => {
			const value = model[key];
			if (typeof value !== 'string') throw new TypeError(`字段${key}必须为string`);
			return value;
		};
		return {
			name: text('name'),
			team: text('team'),
			status: text('status'),
			owner: text('owner'),
			email: text('email'),
			note: text('note')
		};
	}
};
export interface ExtraFields {
	reference: string;
	category: string;
	region: string | null;
	priority: string;
	startDate: string | null;
	dueDate: string | null;
	budget: number;
	progress: number;
	channels: string[];
	enabled: boolean;
	tags: string[];
	time: string | null;
	attachments: AsamUploadedResource[];
}
export type RichRow = BaseRow & ExtraFields;
export type RichEdit = BaseEdit & ExtraFields;
const defaults = (): ExtraFields => ({
	reference: 'LOCAL-DEMO',
	category: '组件演示',
	region: null,
	priority: '中',
	startDate: '',
	dueDate: '',
	budget: 0,
	progress: 0,
	channels: [],
	enabled: false,
	tags: [],
	time: '09:00',
	attachments: []
});
const string = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string';
const strings = (v: unknown): v is string[] => Array.isArray(v) && v.every(string);
const finite = (v: unknown): v is number => typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v);
function resources(v: unknown): v is AsamUploadedResource[] {
	return (
		Array.isArray(v) &&
		v.every(
			(r: unknown) =>
				!!r &&
				typeof r === 'object' &&
				typeof Reflect.get(r, 'id') === 'string' &&
				typeof Reflect.get(r, 'name') === 'string' &&
				typeof Reflect.get(r, 'url') === 'string' &&
				typeof Reflect.get(r, 'mimeType') === 'string' &&
				finite(Reflect.get(r, 'size')) &&
				Reflect.get(r, 'size') >= 0
		)
	);
}
function extras(model: object): ExtraFields {
	const result = defaults();
	for (const key of ['reference', 'category', 'priority'] as const) {
		const value: unknown = Reflect.get(model, key);
		if (value !== undefined) {
			if (!string(value)) throw new TypeError(key);
			result[key] = value;
		}
	}
	for (const key of ['region', 'startDate', 'dueDate', 'time'] as const) {
		const value: unknown = Reflect.get(model, key);
		if (value !== undefined) {
			if (value !== null && !string(value)) throw new TypeError(key);
			result[key] = value;
		}
	}
	for (const key of ['budget', 'progress'] as const) {
		const value: unknown = Reflect.get(model, key);
		if (value !== undefined) {
			if (!finite(value)) throw new TypeError(key);
			result[key] = value;
		}
	}
	for (const key of ['channels', 'tags'] as const) {
		const value: unknown = Reflect.get(model, key);
		if (value !== undefined) {
			if (!strings(value)) throw new TypeError(key);
			result[key] = [...value];
		}
	}
	const enabled: unknown = Reflect.get(model, 'enabled');
	if (enabled !== undefined) {
		if (typeof enabled !== 'boolean') throw new TypeError('enabled');
		result.enabled = enabled;
	}
	const files: unknown = Reflect.get(model, 'attachments');
	if (files !== undefined) {
		if (!resources(files)) throw new TypeError('attachments');
		result.attachments = files.map((file) => ({ ...file }));
	}
	return result;
}
export const richCodec: AsamCrudCodec<RichEdit> = {
	encode: (model) => ({
		...model,
		channels: [...model.channels],
		tags: [...model.tags],
		attachments: model.attachments.map((file) => ({ ...file }))
	}),
	decode: (model) => ({ ...baseCodec.decode(model), ...extras(model) })
};
const source = (values: readonly string[]) =>
	defineAsamOptions().static({ options: values.map((value) => ({ value, label: value })) });
function custom(
	key: keyof ExtraFields,
	label: string,
	component:

		| typeof AsamCascader
		| typeof AsamInputNumber

		| typeof AsamSwitch
		| typeof AsamInputTag
		| typeof AsamTimePicker
		| typeof UploadField,
	valid: (value: unknown) => boolean,
	empty: () => unknown,
	group: string,
	componentProps: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>> = {},
	span?: 1 | 2 | 3
): AsamFieldDefinition {
	return {
		key,
		label,
		kind: 'custom',
		control: defineAsamControl<unknown, object>({
			component,
			emptyValue: empty,
			sourceKinds: []
		}),
		isValue: valid,
		emptyValue: empty,
		isEmpty: (value) =>
			value == null || value === '' || (Array.isArray(value) && !value.length),
		format: (value) =>
			Array.isArray(value)
				? value
						.map((item) =>
							item && typeof item === 'object' && 'name' in item
								? String(item.name)
								: String(item)
						)
						.join('、')
				: String(value ?? '—'),
		query: (value) => value,
		submit: (value) => value,
		modes: { edit: { componentProps, layout: { group, ...(span ? { span } : {}) } } }
	};
}

	budget: Object.is,
	progress: Object.is,

	time: Object.is,

<template>
	<AsamUpload
		:model-value="modelValue"
		multiple
		:upload="upload"
		:disabled="disabled"
		drag
		@update:model-value="update"
	>
		<p>选择或拖入演示附件</p>
		<template #tip>本地合成上传，不连接真实服务。</template>
	</AsamUpload>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { AsamUpload } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamUploadedResource, AsamUploadHandler, AsamUploadValue } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineProps<{ modelValue: readonly AsamUploadedResource[]; disabled?: boolean }>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ 'update:modelValue': [value: AsamUploadedResource[]] }>();
const upload: AsamUploadHandler = async ({ file }, context) => {
	context.reportProgress({ loaded: file.size / 2, total: file.size });
	await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 80));
	if (context.signal.aborted) throw new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError');
	context.reportProgress({ loaded: file.size, total: file.size });
	return {
		id: 'demo-' + file.name + '-' + file.size,
		name: file.name,
		url: '/__local-preview__/' + encodeURIComponent(file.name),
		size: file.size,
		mimeType: file.type || 'application/octet-stream'
	};
};
function update(value: AsamUploadValue) {
	if (Array.isArray(value)) emit('update:modelValue', [...value]);
}
</script>

/** 仅视觉演示内存服务；控制器、校验和写入入口仍消费正常公共包。 */
export function createProjectMock(empty = false) {
	const rows = new Map();
	if (!empty)
		for (let index = 0; index < 24; index++) {
			const id = index + 1;
			rows.set(id, {
				...defaults(),
				id,
				version: 1,
				name: names[index % names.length] + (index >= names.length ? ' · 二期' : ''),
				reference: `PRJ-2026-${String(id).padStart(3, '0')}`,
				owner: owners[index % owners.length],
				status: statuses[[0, 1, 0, 2, 3, 0][index % 6]],
				startDate: '2026-10-01',
				dueDate: `2026-11-${String(5 + index).padStart(2, '0')}`,
				priority: index % 3 ? '中' : '高',
				budget: 48000 + index * 3200,
				progress: [68, 0, 42, 100, 35, 76][index % 6],
				tags: ['重点项目', '跨团队'],
				attachments: [
					{
						id: `project-spec-${id}`,
						name: '项目交付清单与里程碑计划.pdf',
						url: `/__mock-project-documents__/${id}`,
						mimeType: 'application/pdf',
						size: 1887437
					}
				],
				note: '统一项目计划、交付资料与跨团队协作。当前里程碑为完成核心流程联调，下一阶段进入使用反馈与体验优化。'
			});
		}
	let sequence = 100;
	const applied = new Set();
	const services = {
		async list(request) {
			const filtered = [...rows.values()].filter((row) =>
				Object.entries(request.query).every(
					([key, value]) =>
						!value || String(Reflect.get(row, key) ?? '').includes(String(value))
				)
			);
			return {
				list: filtered
					.slice(
						(request.currentPage - 1) * request.pageSize,
						request.currentPage * request.pageSize
					)
					.map((row) => ({ ...copy(row), id: row.id, version: row.version })),
				total: filtered.length
			};
		},
		async defaults() {
			return defaults();
		},
		async load(key) {
			const row = rows.get(key);
			if (!row) throw new Error('项目已不存在');
			return copy(row);
		},
		async create(model, operation) {
			const id = ++sequence;
			rows.set(id, {
				...copy(model),
				id,
				version: 1,
				reference: `PRJ-2026-${String(id).padStart(3, '0')}`
			});
			applied.add(operation.target.operationId);
			return { status: 'success' };
		},
		async update(key, model, operation) {
			const row = rows.get(key);
			if (!row) return { status: 'failure', message: '项目已不存在' };
			rows.set(key, { ...copy(model), id: key, version: row.version + 1 });
			applied.add(operation.target.operationId);
			return { status: 'success' };
		},
		async verify(operation) {
			return {
				status: applied.has(operation.target.operationId) ? 'success' : 'not-applied'
			};
		},
		async resolve(keys) {
			return keys.map((key) => {
				const row = rows.get(key);
				return row
					? {
							key,
							target: {
								key,
								version: String(row.version),
								payload: { name: row.name }
							}
						}
					: { key, reason: '项目已不存在' };
			});
		},
		async remove(target) {
			rows.delete(target.key);
			return { key: target.key, status: 'success' };
		},
		async verifyRemove(target) {
			return { key: target.key, status: rows.has(target.key) ? 'unsent' : 'success' };
		}
	};
	return {
		services,
		async detail(key) {
			const row = rows.get(key);
			return row ? { status: 'ready', data: { ...copy(row) } } : { status: 'missing' };
		},
		complete(keys) {
			for (const key of keys) {
				const row = rows.get(key);
				if (row) rows.set(key, { ...row, status: '已完成', progress: 100 });
			}
		}
	};
}

vue
<template>
	<AsamUpload
		:model-value="modelValue"
		multiple
		:upload="upload"
		:disabled="disabled"
		drag
		@update:model-value="update"
	>
		<p>选择或拖入演示附件</p>
		<template #tip>本地合成上传，不连接真实服务。</template>
	</AsamUpload>
</template>
<script setup>
import { AsamUpload } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineProps({
	modelValue: { type: Array, required: true },
	disabled: { type: Boolean, required: false }
});
const emit = defineEmits(['update:modelValue']);
const upload = async ({ file }, context) => {
	context.reportProgress({ loaded: file.size / 2, total: file.size });
	await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 80));
	if (context.signal.aborted) throw new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError');
	context.reportProgress({ loaded: file.size, total: file.size });
	return {
		id: 'demo-' + file.name + '-' + file.size,
		name: file.name,
		url: '/__local-preview__/' + encodeURIComponent(file.name),
		size: file.size,
		mimeType: file.type || 'application/octet-stream'
	};
};
function update(value) {
	if (Array.isArray(value)) emit('update:modelValue', [...value]);
}
</script>

vue
<template>
	<section class="component-project" data-demo-host>
		<label
			>演示场景<AsamSelect
				:model-value="selected"
				aria-label="演示场景"
				@update:model-value="selectScenario"
				><AsamOption
					v-for="option in options"
					:key="option.value"
					:value="option.value"
					:label="option.label" /></AsamSelect></label
		><AsamConfigProvider :button="{ type: 'primary' }"
			><AsamApplicationProvider
				><component :is="current" :key="selected" /></AsamApplicationProvider
		></AsamConfigProvider>
	</section>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
import { computed, defineAsyncComponent, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamConfigProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamApplicationProvider } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
const options = [
	{ value: 'basic/ts', label: '完整数据操作 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'basic/js', label: '完整数据操作 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'size/ts', label: '紧凑页面 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'size/js', label: '紧凑页面 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'shared/ts', label: '共享查询、表单与详情 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'shared/js', label: '共享查询、表单与详情 (JS)' }
] as const;
const scenarios = {
	'basic/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/basic/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'basic/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/basic/js/Demo.vue')),
	'size/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/size/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'size/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/size/js/Demo.vue')),
	'shared/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/shared/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'shared/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/shared/js/Demo.vue'))
};
const selected = shallowRef<keyof typeof scenarios>('basic/ts');
function selectScenario(value: unknown) {
	const option = options.find((option) => option.value === value);
	if (option) selected.value = option.value;
}
const current = computed(() => scenarios[selected.value]);
</script>

<template>
	<AsamCrudPage
		v-model:border="showBorder"
		:controller="controller"
		:table-size="tableSize"
		:size="size"
		title="项目管理"
		description=""
		create-label="新建项目"
		edit-label="编辑项目"
		detail-label="项目详情"
		:action-column-width="homePreview ? 156 : 228"
		:action-button-type="showActionColors ? 'primary' : undefined"
		:save-button-type="showActionColors ? 'primary' : undefined"
		:cancel-button-type="showActionColors ? 'secondary' : undefined"
		:row-actions="showActionColors ? rowActions : undefined"
		:show-heading="tableOnly ? false : undefined"
		:page-padding="tableOnly ? 0 : undefined"
	>
		<template v-if="tableOnly" #query></template>
	</AsamCrudPage>
	<p v-if="showActionColors" role="status">{{ rowActionMessage }}</p>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { h, onBeforeUnmount, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamMessageBox, AsamTag, createAsamDataRuntime } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamControlSize, AsamTableSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamCrudPage, useAsamCrudController } from '@asam-ui/pro/templates/crud';
import {
	createAsamWriteCoordinator,
	createAsamTableOperationCoordinator
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamListAction } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import {
	createProjectMock,
	initialProjectQuery,
	projectEditorConfig,
	projectQueryCodec,
	projectQueryFields
} from './project/ProjectMock.js';
import type { ProjectQuery } from './project/ProjectMock.js';
import type { RichEdit, RichRow } from './project/RichFields.js';

defineOptions({ name: 'SharedCrudExample' });
const props = defineProps<{
	tableSize?: AsamTableSize;
	size?: AsamControlSize;
	homePreview?: boolean;
	tableOnly?: boolean;
	showActionColors?: boolean;
}>();
const showBorder = shallowRef(false);
const rowActionMessage = shallowRef('可用行内的「查看编号」核对项目。');
const rowActions: readonly AsamListAction<RichRow>[] = [
	{
		id: 'show-reference',
		label: '查看编号',
		button: { type: 'secondary', plain: true },
		scope: 'independent',
		run: async ({ row }) => {
			if (row) rowActionMessage.value = `${row.name}：${row.reference}`;
		}
	}
];
const mock = createProjectMock();
const runtime = createAsamDataRuntime();
let sequence = 0;
const confirm = (message: string) =>
	AsamMessageBox.confirm(message, '请确认').then(
		() => true,
		() => false
	);
const tone = (status: string) =>
	status === '进行中'
		? 'primary'
		: status === '已完成'
			? 'success'
			: status === '待启动'
				? 'warning'
				: 'info';
const controller = useAsamCrudController<RichRow, ProjectQuery, RichEdit, string | number>({
	runtime,
	writes: createAsamWriteCoordinator(),
	operations: createAsamTableOperationCoordinator(),
	rowKey: (row: RichRow) => row.id,
	isKey: (key: unknown): key is string | number =>
		typeof key === 'string' || (typeof key === 'number' && Number.isFinite(key)),
	dataset: 'website-projects',
	initial: { ...initialProjectQuery },
	queryFields: projectQueryFields,
	queryCodec: projectQueryCodec,
	...projectEditorConfig,
	services: mock.services,
	detail: { mode: 'load', load: mock.detail },
	columns: [
		{ key: 'name', label: '项目名称', width: props.homePreview ? 180 : 240, required: true },
		...(!props.tableOnly
			? [
					{
						key: 'reference' as const,
						label: '项目编号',
						width: props.homePreview ? 140 : 150,
						flex: false
					}
				]
			: []),
		{ key: 'owner', label: '负责人', width: props.homePreview ? 84 : 96, flex: false },
		{
			key: 'status',
			label: '状态',
			width: props.homePreview ? 96 : 110,
			flex: false,
			render: (row: RichRow) =>
				h(AsamTag, { type: tone(row.status), effect: 'light' }, () => row.status)
		},
		{ key: 'dueDate', label: '截止日期', width: props.homePreview ? 96 : 126, flex: false }
	],
	preferences: {
		scope: {
			application: 'docs',
			principal: 'visitor',
			table: 'website-projects',
			version: '2'
		},
		adapter: { load: async () => null, save: async () => {}, reset: async () => {} }
	},
	allowed: () => true,
	allowedRemove: () => true,
	confirmDiscard: () => confirm('放弃未保存内容？'),
	confirmRemove: () => confirm('删除所选项目？'),
	operationId: (action) => `website-${action}-${++sequence}`
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	controller.dispose();
	runtime.invalidate();
});
</script>
ts
import type { AsamCrudCodec, AsamCrudServices } from '@asam-ui/pro/templates/crud';
import type { AsamFieldDefinition } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { defineAsamOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamOption } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { richCodec, richEquals, richFields } from './RichFields.js';
import type { RichEdit, RichRow } from './RichFields.js';

export interface ProjectQuery {
	name: string;
	owner: string | null;
	status: string | null;
	reference: string;
	dueDate: string | null;
	priority: string | null;
}
export const initialProjectQuery: ProjectQuery = {
	name: '',
	owner: null,
	status: null,
	reference: '',
	dueDate: null,
	priority: null
};
export const owners = ['陈晨', '林悦', '张远', '许宁', '周可', '沈知'];
export const statuses = ['进行中', '待启动', '已完成', '已暂停'];
const names = [
	'华东供应链协同平台',
	'园区设备巡检',
	'研发知识库升级',
	'客户服务工作台',
	'渠道结算自动化',
	'华南仓储可视化',
	'数据治理与指标口径统一',
	'生产计划排程',
	'质量追溯系统',
	'移动审批助手',
	'合同归档与检索',
	'团队协作空间'
];
const source = (values: readonly string[]) =>
	defineAsamOptions().static({ options: values.map((value) => ({ value, label: value })) });
const choice = (key: string, label: string, values: readonly string[]): AsamFieldDefinition => ({
	key,
	label,
	kind: 'single',
	source: source(values),
	adaptInput: (value) => {
		if (value === '' || value === null || value === undefined) return null;
		if (
			typeof value === 'string' ||
			typeof value === 'boolean' ||
			(typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value))
		)
			return value;
		throw new TypeError('选择值必须是合法标量或空值');
	},
	query: (value) => value ?? '',
	modes: { query: { componentProps: { placeholder: '全部', clearable: true } } }
});
export const projectQueryFields: readonly AsamFieldDefinition[] = [
	{
		key: 'name',
		label: '项目名称',
		kind: 'text',
		modes: { query: { componentProps: { placeholder: '输入项目名称', clearable: true } } }
	},
	choice('owner', '负责人', owners),
	choice('status', '项目状态', statuses),
	{
		key: 'reference',
		label: '项目编号',
		kind: 'text',
		modes: { query: { componentProps: { placeholder: '如 PRJ-2026-001', clearable: true } } }
	},
	{
		...richFields.find((field) => field.key === 'dueDate')!,
		modes: {
			query: {
				componentProps: {
					valueFormat: 'YYYY-MM-DD',
					placeholder: '选择日期',
					clearable: true
				}
			}
		}
	},
	choice('priority', '优先级', ['高', '中', '低'])
];
export const projectQueryCodec: AsamCrudCodec<ProjectQuery> = {
	encode: (model) => ({
		...model,
		owner: model.owner || null,
		status: model.status || null,
		priority: model.priority || null
	}),
	decode: (model) => {
		const text = (key: string) => {
			const value = model[key];
			if (value === null || value === undefined) return '';
			if (typeof value !== 'string') throw new TypeError(key);
			return value;
		};
		return {
			name: text('name'),
			owner: text('owner') || null,
			status: text('status') || null,
			reference: text('reference'),
			dueDate: model.dueDate === null ? null : text('dueDate'),
			priority: text('priority') || null
		};
	}
};
const labels: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = {
	name: '项目名称',
	reference: '项目编号',
	category: '项目类型',
	team: '所属团队',
	region: '所属区域',
	status: '项目状态',
	budget: '预算（元）',
	progress: '完成进度',
	channels: '通知渠道',
	enabled: '截止提醒',
	tags: '项目标签',
	time: '提醒时间',
	attachments: '交付附件',
	note: '项目说明'
};
const fieldOrder = [
	'name',
	'reference',
	'category',
	'owner',
	'team',
	'region',
	'status',
	'priority',
	'startDate',
	'dueDate',
	'budget',
	'progress',
	'channels',
	'enabled',
	'tags',
	'time',
	'email',
	'attachments',
	'note'
];
// JS 投影也保留返回类型，避免嵌套字段模式推导成庞大联合。
const definitions = fieldOrder.map(
	/** @returns {import('@asam-ui/pro').AsamFieldDefinition} */ (key): AsamFieldDefinition => {
		const field = richFields.find((item) => item.key === key)!;
		const label = labels[field.key] ?? field.label;
		const group = ['name', 'reference', 'category', 'owner', 'team', 'region'].includes(
			field.key
		)
			? '基本信息'
			: ['status', 'priority', 'startDate', 'dueDate', 'budget', 'progress'].includes(
						field.key
				  )
				? '计划安排'
				: ['attachments', 'note'].includes(field.key)
					? '附件与说明'
					: '协作设置';
		const layout = { ...field.modes?.edit?.layout, group };
		const modes = {
			...field.modes,
			edit: { ...field.modes?.edit, layout },
			detail: { ...field.modes?.detail, layout }
		};
		if (field.key === 'email')
			return {
				...field,
				label,
				submitHidden: true,
				submit: (value: unknown) => value,
				modes: {
					...modes,
					edit: { ...modes.edit, hidden: true },
					detail: { ...modes.detail, hidden: true }
				}
			};
		if (field.key === 'region')
			return {
				...field,
				label,
				format: (value: unknown) =>
					value === 'hz' ? '中国 / 浙江 / 杭州' : String(value ?? '—'),
				modes: {
					...modes,
					edit: {
						...modes.edit,
						componentProps: {
							props: { emitPath: false },
							placeholder: '请选择区域',
							options: [
								{
									value: 'cn',
									label: '中国',
									raw: { code: 'cn' },
									children: [
										{
											value: 'zj',
											label: '浙江',
											raw: { code: 'zj' },
											children: [
												{ value: 'hz', label: '杭州', raw: { code: 'hz' } }
											]
										}
									]
								}
							] satisfies readonly AsamOption<string, { code: string }>[]
						}
					}
				}
			};
		if (field.key === 'reference')
			return {
				...field,
				label,
				modes: {
					...modes,
					edit: { ...modes.edit, readonly: false, componentProps: { readonly: true } }
				}
			};
		if (field.key === 'name' || field.key === 'owner')
			return {
				...field,
				label,
				modes: {
					...modes,
					edit: {
						...modes.edit,
						componentProps: {
							placeholder:
								field.key === 'name' ? '请输入项目名称' : '输入或选择负责人'
						}
					}
				}
			};
		if (field.key === 'progress')
			return {
				...field,
				label,
				format: (value: unknown) => `${String(value)}%`,
				modes: {
					...modes,
					edit: {
						...modes.edit,
						componentProps: { ...modes.edit.componentProps, showInput: true }
					}
				}
			};
		if (field.key === 'enabled')
			return {
				...field,
				label: '截止提醒',
				format: (value: unknown) => (value ? '开启' : '关闭'),
				modes: {
					...modes,
					edit: {
						...modes.edit,
						componentProps: { activeText: '已开启', inactiveText: '已关闭' }
					}
				}
			};
		if (field.key === 'tags' || field.key === 'note')
			return {
				...field,
				label,
				modes: {
					...modes,
					edit: {
						...modes.edit,
						componentProps: {
							...modes.edit.componentProps,
							placeholder:
								field.key === 'tags'
									? '输入后按 Enter 添加'
									: '填写目标、交付范围或协作事项',
							...(field.key === 'note' ? { rows: 3 } : {})
						}
					}
				}
			};
		if (field.kind === 'single') {
			const values =
				field.key === 'status'
					? statuses
					: field.key === 'category'
						? ['平台建设', '流程优化', '数据分析']
						: field.key === 'team'
							? ['平台研发组', '客户体验组', '运营协作组']
							: undefined;
			if (values)
				return { ...field, label, source: source(values), control: 'select', modes };
		}
		return { ...field, label, modes };
	}
);
export const projectFields = definitions;
export const projectEditorConfig = {
	editFields: projectFields,
	detailFields: projectFields,
	editCodec: richCodec,
	equals: richEquals
};
function copy(model: RichEdit): RichEdit {
	return richCodec.decode(richCodec.encode(model));
}
function defaults(): RichEdit {
	return richCodec.decode({
		name: '',
		reference: '保存后自动生成',
		owner: '',
		team: '平台研发组',
		category: '平台建设',
		region: 'hz',
		status: '待启动',
		email: '',
		note: '',
		startDate: '2026-10-30',
		dueDate: '2026-11-30',
		priority: '中',
		budget: 0,
		progress: 0
	});
}
/** 仅视觉演示内存服务；控制器、校验和写入入口仍消费正常公共包。 */
export function createProjectMock(empty = false) {
	const rows = new Map<string | number, RichRow>();
	if (!empty)
		for (let index = 0; index < 24; index++) {
			const id = index + 1;
			rows.set(id, {
				...defaults(),
				id,
				version: 1,
				name: names[index % names.length]! + (index >= names.length ? ' · 二期' : ''),
				reference: `PRJ-2026-${String(id).padStart(3, '0')}`,
				owner: owners[index % owners.length]!,
				status: statuses[[0, 1, 0, 2, 3, 0][index % 6]!]!,
				startDate: '2026-10-01',
				dueDate: `2026-11-${String(5 + index).padStart(2, '0')}`,
				priority: index % 3 ? '中' : '高',
				budget: 48000 + index * 3200,
				progress: [68, 0, 42, 100, 35, 76][index % 6]!,
				tags: ['重点项目', '跨团队'],
				attachments: [
					{
						id: `project-spec-${id}`,
						name: '项目交付清单与里程碑计划.pdf',
						url: `/__mock-project-documents__/${id}`,
						mimeType: 'application/pdf',
						size: 1887437
					}
				],
				note: '统一项目计划、交付资料与跨团队协作。当前里程碑为完成核心流程联调，下一阶段进入使用反馈与体验优化。'
			});
		}
	let sequence = 100;
	const applied = new Set<string>();
	const services: AsamCrudServices<RichRow, ProjectQuery, RichEdit, string | number> = {
		async list(request) {
			const filtered = [...rows.values()].filter((row) =>
				Object.entries(request.query).every(
					([key, value]) =>
						!value || String(Reflect.get(row, key) ?? '').includes(String(value))
				)
			);
			return {
				list: filtered
					.slice(
						(request.currentPage - 1) * request.pageSize,
						request.currentPage * request.pageSize
					)
					.map((row) => ({ ...copy(row), id: row.id, version: row.version })),
				total: filtered.length
			};
		},
		async defaults() {
			return defaults();
		},
		async load(key) {
			const row = rows.get(key);
			if (!row) throw new Error('项目已不存在');
			return copy(row);
		},
		async create(model, operation) {
			const id = ++sequence;
			rows.set(id, {
				...copy(model),
				id,
				version: 1,
				reference: `PRJ-2026-${String(id).padStart(3, '0')}`
			});
			applied.add(operation.target.operationId);
			return { status: 'success' };
		},
		async update(key, model, operation) {
			const row = rows.get(key);
			if (!row) return { status: 'failure', message: '项目已不存在' };
			rows.set(key, { ...copy(model), id: key, version: row.version + 1 });
			applied.add(operation.target.operationId);
			return { status: 'success' };
		},
		async verify(operation) {
			return {
				status: applied.has(operation.target.operationId) ? 'success' : 'not-applied'
			};
		},
		async resolve(keys) {
			return keys.map((key) => {
				const row = rows.get(key);
				return row
					? {
							key,
							target: {
								key,
								version: String(row.version),
								payload: { name: row.name }
							}
						}
					: { key, reason: '项目已不存在' };
			});
		},
		async remove(target) {
			rows.delete(target.key);
			return { key: target.key, status: 'success' };
		},
		async verifyRemove(target) {
			return { key: target.key, status: rows.has(target.key) ? 'unsent' : 'success' };
		}
	};
	return {
		services,
		async detail(key: string | number) {
			const row = rows.get(key);
			return row
				? { status: 'ready' as const, data: { ...copy(row) } }
				: { status: 'missing' as const };
		},
		complete(keys: readonly (string | number)[]) {
			for (const key of keys) {
				const row = rows.get(key);
				if (row) rows.set(key, { ...row, status: '已完成', progress: 100 });
			}
		}
	};
}

import {

	AsamDatePicker,
	AsamInputNumber,
	AsamInputTag,
	AsamSlider,
	AsamSwitch,
	AsamTimePicker,
	defineAsamControl,
	defineAsamOptions
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamUploadedResource } from '@asam-ui/ui';
